name: Admin Secure Link Management
description: Admin views, searches and filters secure links by ready, sent, opened, expired and revoked lifecycle states, including received links and audit history, and reloads the list from the panel refresh button. Each row starts with an unlabeled three-dot button that opens an actions modal: detail and history, edit content, copy URL, manual sent mark, revoke or reactivate, and delete. The admin can manually mark an active team-created link as sent, which records the acknowledgement without sending a message; can reveal content without consuming the public link, rename the title in place from the detail, edit the content through a single edit option, revoke, reactivate or delete it. A recipient explicitly revealing the public link changes the displayed lifecycle to opened; reactivation returns it to ready. Copying the public client page keeps the button label and header geometry stable, confirms actual clipboard success with a temporary check and floating accessible status, and permits retry after clipboard failure. The admin navigates a dedicated hierarchy of automatic project folders, manual folders and subfolders using shared document-manager navigation, including the mobile drawer. Folder and descendant scope applies to search, lifecycle tabs and received counts; client mode groups by the actual associated client. The admin creates, renames, moves, reorders, archives, restores or deletes empty folders and moves links without changing ownership. Archive keeps live links valid. Failed saves and stale move conflicts preserve the dialog and allow retry.
